# Hipstersmoothie

Hipstersmoothie applies a low-contrast visual style with balanced colors and readable typography across the editor, sidebars and interface elements. The recorded description presents the result as a cohesive workspace that keeps focus on notes, and the theme index lists dark mode only.

![Hipstersmoothie screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hipstersmoothie/hipstersmoothie-obsidian-theme/HEAD/hipstersmoothie-obsidian-theme.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Hipstersmoothie"
    author: "hipstersmoothie"
    repo:   "hipstersmoothie/hipstersmoothie-obsidian-theme"
    slug:   "hipstersmoothie"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/hipstersmoothie"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/hipstersmoothie/hipstersmoothie-obsidian-theme"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hipstersmoothie/hipstersmoothie-obsidian-theme/HEAD/hipstersmoothie-obsidian-theme.png"

    modes: ["dark"]
    about: "Apply a smooth, hip visual style to Obsidian with balanced colors and readable typography. Style the editor, sidebars, and UI elements for a cohesive, low-contrast workspace that keeps focus on your notes."
}
```
